ann: An intro plays showing young boys playing cricket on a beach.
Dancers begin to gather and hype up the surrounding crowd on a busy city street
A woman in a yellow shirt steps into the clearing of a busy street and starts dancing, officially kicking off the flash mob.
A large group of dancers runs into the center circle, synchronizing their choreography as the massive crowd watches.
Spectators watch the performance from a balcony while rickshaws pass by the crowd
A man vigorously waves a flag from above, overlooking the massive street crowd watching the performance.
A man wearing a hat and grey tank top takes the center of the circle to perform an energetic solo breakdance routine.
A quick, chaotic cutaway shows a large white bull being led through the busy street right next to the event.
The camera pans across the massive street crowd as the full group of dancers performs their most synchronized sequence of the song.
The performance ends abruptly, and the dancers immediately scatter, blending back into the dense street crowd.
